visualCharacteristics: Two columns inside a grey section panel: an intro column (h2, paragraph with footnote superscripts, primary and secondary buttons side by side with a 5px gap) and a narrow column of stacked statistics (Playfair 24/34 plum value over a 19/26 label, 31px between stats). Mobile: stacked, full-width buttons.
contentPattern: Row 1: one cell with heading, paragraph and button links. Each following row: value | label. A stat row may also be a single cell with a heading (value) and a paragraph (label).

usage.description: Company highlights such as 'The Jackson difference', with key figures beside the intro copy. Place in a section styled grey.

reuseGuidance: Use for 2-5 short figures. Keep values short (e.g. '$338 billion'); footnote markers go in the label as superscript.
